products.name: Blender AI Add-ons
products.note: 3D creation AI plugins; open-source; local processing; model provenance varies by plugin

profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source organization that develops and maintains Blender, a free 3D creation suite available to anyone. The software covers a wide range of disciplines including 3D modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, visual effects, camera and object tracking, and 2D drawing within a 3D viewport. The foundation describes Blender as having a flexible Python-controlled interface and an extensive add-on ecosystem built by community developers and distributed through global marketplaces. Blender is a member of the Academy Software Foundation, Khronos, the Linux Foundation, and the Open Invention Network, and the project receives hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks a product category called Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins that bring AI capabilities into the Blender environment, run processing locally, and vary in model provenance depending on the individual plugin. Upcoming work noted on the site includes a Cycles Texture Cache feature planned for Blender 5.2 LTS, intended to make rendering scenes with many image textures more memory efficient. The foundation also runs an ongoing open production project called OVERGROWN, which it periodically opens to the public as a reference for how large Blender productions are assembled.

No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations appear in the held data for this organization.
